endpoint.recipe: fixed https://preview.tf.selcloud.ru/v1 with exact override support
endpoint.scope: exact caller project, caller-asserted key binding

request.mapping: explicit model; text role/content messages; stream false; no business defaults
request.token_bound: optional caller max_tokens as nonnegative exact Integer; no model limit guessed; absent omitted
request.reasoning: Router only: explicit nested reasoning.effort=low from first-party quickstart; absent omitted, unsupported services/effort rejected locally

response.completeness: bounded JSON, partial parameter surface; unknown Selectel-specific full response/deployment inventory
response.usage: exact Integer counters, optional usage; absent is not zero
response.refs: completion/model IDs remain protected metadata; no resource/task ref or wait

errors.mapping: core HTTP mapping; raw messages/body discarded; accepted malformed/body-limit error retains Receipt

retry: all model POST mutations: no automatic replay, no idempotency assumptions
